_comment: Buy-path Sanity reads that must bypass the 60 s data cache (sanityFetch live: true). Consumed by scripts/checks/buy-path-live-reads.mts (rule 1 and 2) and by checks/mutate_live_reads.py (mutations). A sanityFetch call passes when its options object has a `live` property whose value is the literal `true` or the identifier `live` (the loadTicketCardViewModels parameter). A call that omits `live` or passes `live: false` FAILS unless its query is listed in `allow_not_live`. An `allow_not_live` query_identifier must be bound exactly once in the file, by an unaliased value import from a module ending sanity/queries; a parameter, local, alias or other module of that name FAILS. An options object with a spread, computed key, accessor or method member, or a repeated live/query key FAILS even when its query is allowlisted (PR #160 Codex findings).

allow_not_live.reason: page copy strings (sold-out and sales-closed messages); accepted 60 s staleness per docs/sanity-request-volume.md

capacity-pool sibling membership and headcountPerUnit for the sold-out display only; shared with the hub through loadTicketCardViewModels, so making it live would raise hub Sanity volume; checkout re-reads live. Open question for the team lead, see spec.md finding 2

_minimum_sites_note: Guards against a checker that silently finds zero calls (renamed import, wrapper) and so passes vacuously. A file with fewer matched calls than listed fails with setup error exit 2.

mutations._note: layout.tsx has no direct sanityFetch today; M9 proves a NEW non-live sanityFetch added to a covered file is caught
aliased import: sf({...}) with no live
namespace import: sx.sanityFetch({...}) with no live
non-call reference: const w = sanityFetch; w({...}) with no live
local const live = false passed as shorthand `live`
local const live = false passed as `live: live`
a Sanity client under another name: sanityClient.fetch(...) bypasses sanityFetch altogether

edits.replace:
import { sanityFetch } from '@/sanity/lib/fetch';
import { client as sanityClient } from '@/sanity/lib/client';

_dodge_rules: Mutations D1-D6 are QA-found dodges (M3/F4 QA, 2026-10-29). The checker must (a) resolve aliased and namespace imports of the sanityFetch module (any specifier ending sanity/lib/fetch, relative or alias) to the same callee; (b) flag any NON-call reference to sanityFetch in a covered file (assignment, argument, array/object member) as a violation; (c) accept the `live` identifier (shorthand or `live: live`) only when it resolves to a parameter of the enclosing function, never a local const or outer variable; (d) flag any `.fetch(` call whose receiver resolves to a binding imported from a sanity/lib/client module (any import name) or created by createClient in the file, in addition to the literal receiver `client`.
